Malheureusement pour lui, les plans en question ont déjà été diffusés dans la série Les Simpson. Pendant ce temps, Stan, Kyle et Cartman sont persuadés d'avoir tué Mme Crockelpaf.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E08 - Les cathos, c'est chaud
6.plot: Le Père Maxi est inquiet au sujet de sa paroisse et de la méfiance des habitants envers les prêtres. Il se rend donc à la Cité du Vatican pour changer le « saint-document des lois vaticanes ». Pendant ce temps, South Park devient athée, et les gens décident de manger par le rectum et de déféquer par la bouche.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E09 - Bérets gratos
6.plot:
Stan, Kyle, Cartman et Tweek vont voir au cinéma, pour sa re-resortie, Star Wars, épisode V : L'Empire contre-attaque. Mais ils sont atterrés de découvrir que George Lucas a ressorti des versions sans violence des films de E.T., Il faut sauver le soldat Ryan et Star Wars, épisode V : L'Empire contre-attaque en remplaçant les armes par des talkies-walkies et certains mots comme le mot terroriste qui sera remplacé par hippie.

Les quatre enfants décident alors de fonder une association pour défendre le droit de ne pas modifier les films.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E10 - Les seins de Bébé mettent en danger la société
6.plot: Barbara, alias Bébé, voit sa puberté arriver bien vite et ses seins commencent à pousser. Les garçons lui trouvent un intérêt soudain et la vénèrent comme une des leurs, ce qui rend les autres filles très jalouses.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E11 - Les enlèvements d'enfants, c'est pas marrant
6.plot: Les parents sont victimes de la psychose de l'enlèvement. Au fil des informations, ils apprennent que leurs enfants peuvent être enlevés par eux-mêmes. Mme le Maire demande au Chinois Tuong Lu Kim, propriétaire du restaurant City Wok, d'édifier une muraille comme dans son pays mais les Mongols l'attaquent.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E12 - Une échelle pour aller au ciel
6.plot:
Kyle, Stan et Cartman ont gagné une razzia gratuite de bonbons à la confiserie Lolly. Malheureusement, pour faire valoir leur droit aux confiseries, ils doivent retrouver leur ticket gagnant, qu’ils avaient confié à Kenny, mort peu de temps auparavant. Les trois garçons décident alors de bâtir une gigantesque échelle pour aller au ciel, dans l’espoir de l’y retrouver. Pendant ce temps, le gouvernement américain soupçonne Saddam Hussein d’être en train de construire des armes de destruction massive du haut du paradis. Ils décident alors de se servir de l’échelle des garçons pour le bombarder.

Cet épisode parodie l’arrivée sur la Lune des Américains en parodiant les théories proposées, notamment lors du tournage de l’arrivée au paradis des Japonais.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E13 - Le Retour de la communauté de l'anneau des deux tours
6.plot: Les parents de Stan veulent prêter une cassette du Seigneur des Anneaux à la famille de Butters car celui-ci voudrait la voir. Ils la confient donc aux enfants (Stan, Kyle, Cartman et Kenny qui est dans le corps de Cartman) qui sont déguisés en personnages du style heroic fantasy et profitent de leur absence pour regarder l'autre cassette qu'ils ont louée et qui s'avère être un film pornographique. Mais ils découvrent avec stupeur qu'ils ont interverti les deux cassettes. S'ensuit une course contre la montre pour récupérer la cassette et réparer les dégâts causés par le visionnage du film X.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E14 - Le Camp de la mort de tolérance
6.plot: M. Garrison est réengagé pour enseigner au CM1 après la mort de Mme Crockelpaf. Homosexuel, il apprend que s'il est viré il pourrait porter plainte et obtenir 25 millions de dollars d'indemnité pour homophobie. Appâté par le gain, Garrison se lance alors dans des actes sexuels inappropriés avec son compagnon M. Esclave devant ses élèves, dans le but de se faire virer. Les enfants, choqués par son comportement, tentent de le dénoncer, mais leurs parents considèrent cela comme de l'intolérance et leur font visiter le Musée de la Tolérance afin de les éduquer.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E15 - Le Plus Gros Connard de l'univers
6.plot: Au début de l'épisode, Cartman est emmené à l'hôpital. Après intervention de Chef, il s'avère qu'Eric a besoin d'être désenvouté de l'âme de Kenny (qu'il a ingéré dans Une échelle pour aller au ciel). Pendant ce temps, Stan tente de prouver au monde que John Edward, un médium qui tient son émission de télévision, n'est qu'un imposteur.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E16 - Mon futur moi et moi
6.plot: Un homme se présentant comme Stan Marsh arrive à South Park, prétendant arriver du futur. Le « Stan du passé » (c'est-à-dire le « Stan actuel ») est tout d'abord effaré de voir son « futur moi » ressembler à une véritable loque humaine, mais il comprend bientôt que cet « homme du futur » cache quelque chose de louche.

6.title: FR - South Park - S06E17 - La Chute du traîneau rouge
6.plot: Cartman est très tendu. Il a commis trop de mauvaises actions pour espérer avoir des cadeaux à Noël. Il tente alors de se racheter en convainquant le Père Noël d'apporter Noël en Irak. Malheureusement, celui-ci s'écrase dans son traîneau sur Bagdad.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E01 - Wird die Erde eingestellt?
7.plot: Stan, Cartman, Kyle und Kenny finden heraus, dass die Erde nur eine gigantische intergalaktische Reality-Show ist, die kurz davor steht abgesetzt zu werden.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E02 - Guter Krüppel, schlechter Krüppel
7.plot: Jimmy und Timmy machen sich auf die Suche nach Gleichgesinnten und treffen auf die Crips. Sie ahnen nicht, dass es sich hierbei nicht um Behinderte handelt, die nach Anerkennung suchen, sondern um eine brutale Gang.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E03 - Das Schweigen des Klopapiers
7.plot: Cartman und die Jungs beschmeißen das Haus einer Lehrerin mit Toilettenpapier. Danach leidet Kyle unter einem sehr schlechten Gewissen. Cartman beschließt, Kyle zu töten, damit er sie nicht verrät.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E04 - Fehlgeburt einer Nation
7.plot: In South Park kommt es während des Irakkriegs zu Anti-Kriegs-Demonstrationen. Stan, Kyle und Kenny nehmen an einer Demo teil, um nicht zur Schule zu müssen. Währenddessen versucht Cartman, einen "Flashback" zu bekommen.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E05 - J-Lo: Das doppelte Flittchen
7.plot: Cartman's Hand wird über Nacht berühmt. Er macht mit diesem Körperteil Jennifer Lopez nach - und alle sind davon hin und weg. Die Plattenfirma bietet ihm sogar einen Vertrag an.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E06 - Kleine Kriminale
7.plot: Die Kids starten mit ihrer eigenen South Park Detektiv Agentur. Nachdem sie einem kleinen Mädchen geholfen haben, ihr Puppe wiederzufinden, werden sie von der Polizei zu Junior Cops ernannt. Ihr nächster Auftrag: Ein Drogenlabor auffliegen lassen!

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E07 - Unglaublich geldgeile Ureinwohner
7.plot: Die Besitzer des großen indianischen Casinos Three Feathers haben South Park aufgekauft. Sie wollen einen neuen Super Highway bauen und die Bürger dazu zwingen ihr Land zu verlassen. Das können die Kids nicht zulassen.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E08 - Schwule Verschwörung
7.plot: South Park feiert die neue hippe Metrosexualität. Cartman, Stan und Kenny sind total heiß darauf schwul zu sein. Kyle hingegen wird von seinen Freunden ausgeschlossen, weil er sich nicht metrosexuell fühlt.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E09 - Christen rocken fett!
7.plot: Als die anderen Jungs Cartman aus deren Band schmeißen, gründet er eine eigene christliche Rockband. Während Cartman's Band die Spitze der Charts erklimmt werden Stan, Kyle und Kenny verhaftet weil sie sich Musik aus dem Internet runter geladen haben.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E10 - Revolution der alten Säcke
7.plot: Die Senioren müssen ihre Führerscheine abgeben, nachdem sie auf der Straße ein Chaos angerichtet haben. Stans Großvater bitte die AARP um Hilfe.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E11 - Casa Bonita
7.plot: Kyle's Eltern gehen mit ihm und seinen Freunden Stan, Kenny und Butters zu seinem Geburtstag ins Casa Bonita. Als Cartman herausfindet, dass er nicht eingeladen ist, sorgt er dafür, dass Butters verschwindet.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E12 - Mormonen machen sich was vor
7.plot: Eine Mormonenfamilie zieht mit ihrem Sohn Gary nach South Park. Eric freundet sich mit Gary an, ist von der ganzen Mormonen-Sache jedoch enttäuscht.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E13 - Kippe weg!
7.plot: Die Kids werden beim Rauchen erwischt und die Schule geht in Flammen auf. Eine radikale Anti-Raucher-Gruppe taucht auf und will Cartmann umbringen, um die Gefahr des Passivrauchens aufzuzeigen.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E14 - Wir sind Grufties
7.plot: Nachdem Wendy mit Stan Schluss gemacht hat, wird dieser zum Grufti und versinkt in seinem Schmerz.

7.title: FR - South Park - S07E15 - Blöder die Kanadier nie klingen!
7.plot: Kyles Adoptivbruder Ike wird von seinen leiblichen Eltern nach Kanada zurück geholt, denn der neue kanadische Ministerpräsident hat verfügt, dass alle kanadischen Kinder, die adoptiert wurden, ins Land zurückkommen müssen.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E01 - Good Times with Weapons
8.plot: South Park takes on the look of Japanese Anime. The boys are transformed into Japanese Warriors after they buy martial arts weapons at a local flea market. Their sworn enemy, Professor Chaos, confronts them and a highly stylized battle ensues.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E02 - Up the Down Steroid
8.plot: Jimmy is in training for an upcoming sporting event and he’s determined to win at any cost. Cartman feels he can easily take first place against Jimmy. He just has to convince the qualifying committee he’s handicapped.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E03 - The Passion of the Jew
8.plot: Kyle finally sees “The Passion” and is forced to admit Cartman has been right all along. Meanwhile many of the film’s hardcore fans band together under Cartman’s leadership to carry out it’s message.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E04 - You Got F'd in the A
8.plot: It’s up to Stan to put a team of South Park’s best dancers together to compete against a rival troupe from Orange County. While Butters has won awards for his dancing, he refuses to help Stan out, as he hasn’t been able to dance since the tragic death of eight audience members at his last competition.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E05 - AWESOM-O
8.plot: Cartman dresses up like a robot, calls himself AWESOM-O, and moves in with Butters. His plan is to learn all of Butter’s innermost secrets and then use them against him. While Butters is thrilled to have found a new best friend, the Army believes AWESOM-O is some new secret weapon, and Hollywood is after the phony robot to develop their next big blockbuster.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E06 - The Jeffersons
8.plot: All the children of South Park are attracted to Mr. Jefferson, his son and their home filled with games, toys and animals. Cartman goes out of his way to get Mr. Jefferson to love him while the local police force resent him for being black and wealthy and decide bring him down.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E07 - Goobacks
8.plot: Humans from the year 4035 are arriving in droves in South Park! Everything gets a little too crowded when people from the future arrive through a recently discovered time portal. When the boys try to earn some extra money, the time immigrants, who are willing to do the same work for next to nothing, take their jobs.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E08 - Douche and Turd
8.plot: When PETA demonstrates against the use of a cow as South Park Elementary’s mascot, the student body is forced to choose a new one. As the election approaches, Kyle tries to convince everyone that his candidate, a giant douche, is better than Cartman’s nominee, a turd sandwich.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E09 - Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
8.plot: The streets of South Park are like a ghost-town when a giant Wall-Mart lures all the townspeople to the new store with its incredible bargains. Cartman becomes a boy possessed by the power of Wall-Mart and its low, low prices. In order to save their town, Stan and Kyle have to find a way to destroy the ever-expanding superstore while keeping Cartman from stabbing them in the back.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E10 - Pre-School
8.plot: For five long years, Stan, Kyle, Kenny, Cartman and Butters have kept a secret about a horrible incident that happened back in pre-school. Now, the kid who took the fall for the group, Trent Boyett, is getting out of juvie and his first order of business is revenge.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E11 - Quest for Ratings
8.plot: The boys of South Park produce their own morning news show on the school’s closed-circuit television station and are immediately caught up in the intense competition for ratings.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E12 - Stupid Spoiled Whore Video Playset
8.plot: All the fourth grade girls idolize a rich, famous and spoiled socialite. They even have her brand new toy set that comes complete with video camera, night vision filter, play money and losable cell phone. In an effort to impress their idol, the girls pursue the boys to make their own videos.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E13 - Cartman's Incredible Gift
8.plot: After sustaining a severe head injury, Cartman appears to have the power to see into the future. South Park detectives are quick to enlist his help in cracking unsolved murder cases and Cartman is more than willing to help, for a price. In the meantime, a group of licensed psychics cry foul when Cartman refuses to join their ranks.

8.title: FR - South Park - S08E14 - Woodland Critter Christmas
8.plot: Stan is approached by the forest critters and asked to help them build a manger in anticipation of the birth of their Lord and Savior. Stan complies, only to find out that they serve a very different Lord.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E01 - The Return of Chef
10.plot: The town is excited when Chef returns to town after world traveling with the “Super Adventure Club,” but the boys notice something is different about Chef.  It seems that Chef’s new sense of adventure has gotten the better of him and the boys try to save him.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E02 - Smug Alert
10.plot: Stan is the driving force who gets the citizens of South Park to all buy hybrid cars. Just as everyone starts to feel really good about what they’re doing to help save the earth, a stormy dark mass has started accumulating over the town.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E03 - Cartoon Wars (1)
10.plot: Cartman and Kyle are at war over the popular cartoon, Family Guy. Kyle loves it and Cartman hates it. When the show airs some controversial content the boys go on a cross country chase with the fate of Family Guy lying with the first boy to reach Hollywood.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E04 - Cartoon Wars (2)
10.plot: With Kyle left behind, Cartman makes his way to FOX to get the Family Guy episode pulled, hoping to ultimately get rid of the show once and for all.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E05 - A Million Little Fibers
10.plot: Towelie writes a book and it gets selected for Oprah’s book club.  It becomes a best seller with everyone getting a lot help for their addictions; until a faction of Oprah's staff leak the truth about the book.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E06 - Manbearpig
10.plot: While assisting an ex-Vice President in his quest for attention, the boys get trapped by a cave-in and while searching for a way out, Cartman discovers treasure.  Now he has to figure out how to get out of the cave without the others knowing about it and he can keep it all for himself.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E07 - Tsst
10.plot: When Cartman's mom realizes she can't control her son anymore, she gets help from an expert. Cesar Millan, “The Dog Whisperer" takes on the challenge and while he might have what it takes, Eric Cartman's not going down without a fight.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E08 - Make Love, Not Warcraft
10.plot: A renegade player threatens the Massively Multiplayer Online game World of Warcraft and the fate of the game lay in the hands of Cartman, Kyle, Stan and Kenny.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E09 - Mystery of the Urinal Deuce
10.plot: Cartman reveals who masterminded the attacks of 9/11, while Kyle and Stan search for the real truth; meanwhile Mr. Mackey just wants to know who dropped the deuce in the urinal.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E10 - Miss Teacher Bangs a Boy
10.plot: Cartman, South Park Elementary’s new hallway monitor, takes it personally when he finds out that a teacher has been kissing a student in his jurisdiction.  He helps Kyle stop his little brother’s affair with his “Nice” hot teacher.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E11 - Hell on Earth 2006
10.plot: Satan is throwing the world's biggest Halloween costume party, and no one is getting in without a blue wrist band. Unfortunately, even Satan can't plan for everything as a religious organization and the antics of the most notorious serial killers of all time might ruin his good time.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E12 - Go God Go (1)
10.plot: The topic of evolution is introduced to the 4th graders of South Park Elementary and while their teacher is against the theory a change of mind has implications for the future.  And speaking of the future, Cartman is trying to send himself there; to the exact date that the newest video game console, the Nintendo Wii is being released.

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E13 - Go God Go XII (2)
10.plot: Last week, in an attempt to make his wait for the Wii instantaneous, Cartman froze himself. Through a bizarre twist of fate, he woke up 500 years in the future, where there are warring factions, some angry sea otters, and worst of all: No Nintendo Wii! Will Cartman get out of this crazy future? Or will he be doomed to never get his hands on the Wii?

10.title: FR - South Park - S10E14 - Stanley's Cup
10.plot: Stan becomes coach of a Pee Wee Hockey team and for the benefit of one his players he tries to make them into a team of winners.  Meanwhile his father deals with the memory of Stan’s performance in a Pee Wee hockey game from years earlier, when Stan had the opportunity to score the game winning goal.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E01 - With Apologies to Jesse Jackson
11.plot: Randy uses the "N" word on live TV and faces public ridicule for it and Stan tries to understand Token's feelings on the subject. Meanwhile, a little person visits South Park Elementary and Cartman can't stop himself from laughing at him.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E02 - Cartman Sucks
11.plot: Butters' dad sends him off to special camp to "Pray the Gay Away" when he believes that his son is bi-curious after catching him in a compromising position with Cartman.  Meanwhile, Cartman does his best to retrieve a photo of him in that compromising position before too many people find out about it.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E03 - Lice Capades
11.plot: When a breakout of headlice hits South Park Elementary, Mrs. Garrison refuses to say which child brought the plague to the school. So, Cartman takes it upon himself to find out who it is so the kids can make fun of them. Meanwhile, a louse Travis, is desperate to save his fellow lice from imminent destruction from a conscious world.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E04 - The Snuke
11.plot: The citizens of South Park are gearing up for the arrival of Hillary Clinton for a big campaign rally. Meanwhile, Cartman suspects that a new Muslim student is involved in a possible terrorist attack. Every minute counts for Cartman as he uses his own interrogation methods on his suspect. But could the plan to target Clinton be just the tip of the iceberg?

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E05 - Fantastic Easter Special
11.plot: Stan wants to know the real reason kids have to decorate eggs for Easter, and what, if anything eggs and bunnies have to do with Jesus dying for his sins. To get to the bottom of it, Kyle and Stan get wrapped up in a bizarre society that guards a legendary secret.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E06 - D-Yikes!
11.plot: Once again Ms. Garrison gets dumped, but this time she decides to take it out on her fourth grade class. When the boys have finally had enough of their teacher's erratic mood swings and excessive homework assignments, they find out that there are people-for-hire that can help out in any situation. Meanwhile, Ms. Garrison is finding life without men has its upsides.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E07 - Night of the Living Homeless
11.plot: The number of homeless people in South Park is increasing as they eat, sleep, and beg for change across the town. While the adults try to find creative solutions to deal with the homeless, the boys are trying to figure out a way to solve the problem for good

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E08 - Le Petit Tourette
11.plot: Upon discovering Tourette's syndrome, Cartman becomes mad with power. He finds out he has the ability to say whatever he wants without consequence, so he sets up National TV Coverage to take full advantage of his new found life.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E09 - More Crap
11.plot: Stan's dad becomes South Park's home-town hero when the guys down at the local bar see the size of his most recent crap. Randy contacts a society that keeps track of the world record, thinking his masterpiece would definitely be a contender.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E10 - Imaginationland
11.plot: When the entire contents of the world's imagination lay open before them, Stan and Kyle step right in. Back in South Park, Cartman swears he's seen a leprechaun.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E11 - Imaginationland, Episode II
11.plot: Stan and Kyle are being held captive at the Pentagon until they tell the government exactly how they got into Imaginationland. Elsewhere, Cartman will not give up his quest to make Kyle follow through on their bet to suck his balls.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E12 - Imaginationland, Episode III
11.plot: Inside Imaginationland, Stan and Butters engage in the battle of their lives as they fight the army of evil imaginary forces. Meanwhile, Cartman goes all the way to the Supreme Court to get Kyle to suck his balls.

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E13 - Guitar Queer-O
11.plot: Stan and Kyle become obsessed with Guitar Hero to the point where they're breaking high score records. It doesn't take long for Stan to realize that he could go even further with a different partner. Will the stress of being a rock star get to Stan now that his best friend is no longer by his side?

11.title: FR - South Park - S11E14 - The List
11.plot: The girls in the fourth grade class have made a secret list that rates every boy's looks from cutest to ugliest. When the boys steal the list, they are completely unprepared to deal with the results.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E01 - Tonsil Trouble
12.plot: After going in for a routine tonsillectomy, a botched transfusion leaves Cartman afflicted with an incurable disease. When he finds no comfort in his friends and family, how far will he go to find a cure?

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E02 - Britney's New Look
12.plot: While trying to escape her troubles in the secluded mountains near South Park, Britney Spears has a run-in with the boys. Stan and Kyle get swept up in her celebrity as well as the non-stop feeding frenzy that plagues her wherever she goes. The boys must take Britney to the North Pole when they learn the secret behind what makes her so popular.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E03 - Major Boobage
12.plot: In a South Park homage to the 1981 film, “Heavy Metal”, the boys are trying to get Kenny off the latest drug craze that’s captured the junior high and under set.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E04 - Canada on Strike
12.plot: The head of the World Canadian Bureau leads the country into a long and painful strike and the responsibility of brokering a settlement rests with the boys.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E05 - Eek, A Penis!
12.plot: While Ms. Garrison is off trying to find a way to become the man he was always intended to be, Cartman is put in charge of the classroom.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E06 - Over Logging
12.plot: The citizens of South Park wake up one morning shocked to find the Internet is gone. Upon hearing news that the Internet may remain in California, Randy decides to head out west with the family.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E07 - Super Fun Time
12.plot: While the kids are on an educational field trip to a living museum, Cartman makes Butters sneak away from the class to go to the amusement center located next door.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E08 - The China Probrem
12.plot: After watching the intimidating opening ceremonies of the recent Olympic games, Cartman understands that the Chinese are only just days away from invading his homeland. While the rest of the American people are haunted by the memory of a recent tragic event, only Butters will stand with Cartman as he confronts the Chinese.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E09 - Breast Cancer Show Ever
12.plot: Wendy gets in trouble when she threatens to beat up Cartman after school. No matter how fired up Wendy is, all bets are on Cartman. Everybody knows a girl can't fight a boy and win.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E10 - Pandemic
12.plot: The boys find a way to make money off an international crisis that requires no talent and very little effort. Cartman convinces the other boys to invite Craig to get in on their latest plan. He knows Craig has just what it takes to make their dream a reality.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E11 - Pandemic 2: The Startling
12.plot: Giant guinea pigs are attacking cities all over the world. The boys have the key that will save everyone from the onslaught but they're stranded in the Andes Mountains.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E12 - About Last Night...
12.plot: While the country celebrates the outcome of the election, the new President-elect catches everyone off guard when he arrives at the White House prematurely.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E13 - Elementary School Musical
12.plot: Stan realizes he could lose Wendy if he doesn't get on board with the latest fad to hit South Park Elementary. Cartman would rather kill himself than succumb. But, when Stan, Kyle, Kenny and Cartman all realize that Butters is now more popular than they are, they have no choice but to give in to peer pressure.

12.title: FR - South Park - S12E14 - The Ungroundable
12.plot: Butters is sure he’s seen a vampire at school but he can’t get anyone to listen to him. Meanwhile, the Goth Kids are angry and frustrated when the other kids can’t tell the difference between a Goth and a Vampire.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E01 - The Ring
13.plot: Thinking it's his way into her heart and other body parts, Kenny takes his new girlfriend to a Jonas Brothers concert. His dream of taking their relationship to the next level is crushed when the Jonas Brothers give them purity rings.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E02 - The Coon
13.plot: “The Coon” rises from the trash and takes his place as a lone vigilante who wipes out crime in the town of South Park. A rival superhero appears on the scene in the form of “Mysterion” and challenges the Coon’s place as a “symbol” for the town.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E03 - Margaritaville
13.plot: Randy steps forward with a solution to fix the desperate financial state everyone finds themselves in. The town gets behind him and everyone starts to live a life that no longer depends on any economy at all. Meanwhile an unlikely savior makes the ultimate sacrifice to solve everyone’s problems.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E04 - Eat, Pray, Queef
13.plot: Someone played an April Fools joke on the boys and it didn't go over well. Butters is incapacitated, Cartman is furious and the rest of the boys are afraid someone might do it again.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E05 - Fishsticks
13.plot: Cartman decides to help Jimmy with his comedy routine. Everyone loves the new joke they come up with. The joke starts to take off and it even hits all the late night talk shows. The boys are thrilled with how popular it’s become until somebody tries to take all the credit.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E06 - Pinewood Derby
13.plot: Randy is determined that Stan will win this year's Pinewood Derby. He comes up with a plan that will assure Stan a first place trophy.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E07 - Fatbeard
13.plot: Butters and a small group of recruits join Cartman in his dream of living on skull island. Cartman promises that paradise awaits if they can just get to Somalia.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E08 - Dead Celebrities
13.plot: Powerful forces are tormenting Ike. He's freaked out and the stress could kill him. Kyle and the boys are doing everything they can to save him but the poltergeists won't leave Ike alone.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E09 - Butters' Bottom Bitch
13.plot: Butters has made it all the way to the 4th grade without ever kissing a girl. All of his friends have been teasing him mercilessly. Butters is determined to catch up with the rest of the boys in his class. Meanwhile, one overly dedicated cop wages war on prostitution in South Park.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E10 - W.T.F.
13.plot: The boys have found their new calling in life and they hurry to sign up for the wrestling club. They soon find out the kind of wrestling they teach at school is not the same thing they saw at the WWE.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E11 - Whale Whores
13.plot: Stan and his family are spending his birthday at the Denver Aquarium where they will get to swim with the dolphins. Things turn bloody when the Japanese attack, kill all the dolphins and ruin Stan’s big day. There seems to be no end to the senseless killing. Stan takes on the cause to save the dolphins from the Japanese.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E12 - The F Word
13.plot: Everyone agrees they've had enough of the loud and obnoxious bikers that have arrived in South Park. The boys are taking on the Harley Riders. They thrown down the F word and the game is on.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E13 - Dances With Smurfs
13.plot: Eric Cartman seizes the opportunity to become the voice of change at the school when he takes over the morning announcements. His target is South Park Elementary’s Student Body President, Wendy Testaburger. Cartman is asking the tough questions and gaining followers.

13.title: FR - South Park - S13E14 - Pee
13.plot: Things at the water park are not what they seem. The boys' fun filled day is about to turn deadly. Events are in play at Splash Town that signal the end of the world is upon us. Cartman tries to warn everyone but no one will listen. Disaster is about to strike and the boys are in a race to survive.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E01 - Sexual Healing
14.plot: The nation's top scientists come together to put a stop to the recent phenomenon of rich, successful men who suddenly want to have sex with many, many women. After extensive testing, some of the fourth grade boys in South Park Elementary are diagnosed as sex addicts.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E02 - The Tale of Scrotie McBoogerballs
14.plot: The boys are given a controversial book to read in school that both excites and inspires them to write one of their own. When the boys discover that Stan's mom has found their masterpiece, their new motivation is how they can stay out of trouble.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E03 - Medicinal Fried Chicken
14.plot: State Law in Colorado says it's legal to smoke pot if you have a physician's reference. Randy is the first-in-line to buy some but he's turned away because there's absolutely nothing wrong with him. Randy is desperate to get a medical excuse to smoke some weed but meanwhile, Cartman will do anything to get his beloved fried chicken restaurant back.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E04 - You Have 0 Friends
14.plot: Kyle "friended" the wrong person and now all of his old friends are deserting him. His situation is desperate. Kyle looks for help from the one person who has always been there for him.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E05 - 200
14.plot: While on a school field trip, Stan accidentally insults Tom Cruise and sets off a chain reaction. 200 previously ridiculed celebrities stand strong in a class action lawsuit against the town of South Park.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E06 - 201
14.plot: Angry celebrities, violent ginger kids and Mecha Streisand are about to destroy South Park and all anyone wants to know is, “Who is Eric Cartman’s father?”

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E07 - Crippled Summer
14.plot: Competition is the name of the game this summer. There is no time for Jimmy and his friends to slack off. They're working to be this year's champions at summer camp. Jimmy suits up and prepares to shred in the annual surfing contest.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E08 - Poor and Stupid
14.plot: Cartman wants to race with the pros and he's ready to do whatever it takes to make it happen. He's afraid that no matter how hard he tries, he'll never reach the level of the other NASCAR drivers. Working with Butters as his pit boss, Cartman pulls out all the stops to compete in the race of his life.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E09 - It's a Jersey Thing
14.plot: New Jersey is rapidly taking over the nation one state at a time and their next stop is South Park.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E10 - Insheeption
14.plot: When Stan is sent to the school counselor because he's holding on to an obscene number of useless possessions, he realizes that Mr. Mackey has a hoarding disorder too.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E11 - Coon 2: Hindsight
14.plot: The Coon now leads an entire team of crime-fighters. They are ready to take their place among the worlds most admired and beloved super heroes. But much to the Coons dismay, someone else keeps beating them to the punch. The nation looks to another hero to get them through the BP disaster and dissention develops within the ranks of Coon and friends.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E12 - Mysterion Rises
14.plot: Led by Mysterion, Coon and Friends are working together to help the people in the Gulf who are at the mercy of the dark lord, Cthulhu. The Coon, scorned by his fellow super heroes and now working alone, is out for revenge.

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E13 - Coon vs. Coon & Friends
14.plot: The Coon shows himself to be even more evil than the dark lord, Cthulhu, as he punishes his former partners in Coon & Friends. Kenny McCormick, is wrestling with the weight of his own super power through his alter-ego, Mysterion. Will Coon and Friends save the day? Will Mysterion ever come to terms with his ability to defy death? All this as the nation waits and wonders: Where is Captain Hindsight?

14.title: FR - South Park - S14E14 - Crème Fraiche
14.plot: Stan's life is a shambles both at home and in school. Randy's obsession with the Food Network Is changing everything. It even forces Sharon to explore a new interest of her own.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E01 - HUMANCENTiPAD
15.plot: Kyle is intimately involved in the development of a revolutionary new product that is about to be launched by Apple. Meanwhile, Cartman doesn't even have a regular iPad and blames his mother.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E02 - Funnybot
15.plot: At the school's first annual Comedy Awards, Jimmy announces that the Germans are the least funny people in the world. Germany is highly insulted. They vow that retaliation toward the kids at South Park Elementary will be swift and brutal.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E03 - Royal Pudding
15.plot: The Prince of Canada is about to take a Princess and Ike is obsessed with the Royal Wedding.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E04 - T.M.I.
15.plot: Cartman is furious when he believes that the school has posted their penis sizes on the bulletin board. He throws an absolute fit; takes matters into his own hands and once again finds himself in the principal's office. This time he gets sent to anger management therapy.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E05 - Crack Baby Athletic Association
15.plot:
Cartman has a new protege. He's found someone who is smart, ambitious and willing to look the other way in order to get to the top.

Kyle is brought in on the ground floor of Cartman's latest business venture, the Crack Baby Athletic Adventure.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E06 - City Sushi
15.plot: Butters is diagnosed with multiple personality disorder. Meanwhile, the owner of City Wok is angered when a competing Asian restaurant opens next door.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E07 - You're Getting Old
15.plot: After Stan celebrates his 10th birthday, he begins to see everything differently. The other boys think he's become a major buzzkill and start to avoid hanging out with him. When Stan and Kyle have a major blow up, the very fabric of South Park begins to unravel.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E08 - Ass Burgers
15.plot: Cartman finds a unique way of coping with Asperger's Syndrome. Even Kyle and Kenny are on board. Meanwhile, Stan can't seem to get his life back to normal no matter what he tries. Will anything ever be the same in South Park again?

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E09 - The Last of the Meheecans
15.plot: What begins as an innocent game between the boys turns serious when Cartman joins the U.S. Border Patrol. Not surprisingly, Cartman turns out to be really good at stopping Mexicans.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E10 - Bass to Mouth
15.plot: The students of South Park Elementary are the victims of a new gossip website. An elusive hacker has somehow gained access into the student's confidential phone calls and e-mails and is posting all their juicy stories. The boys are shocked when they discover the identity of the hacker.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E11 - Broadway Bro Down
15.plot: Sharon is thrilled that Randy is making an effort to do more things that she enjoys. But, after he takes her to see a hit musical in Denver, Randy becomes Broadway’s biggest fan. Sharon is whisked away to New York and treated to every musical on the Great White Way.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E12 - 1%
15.plot: The kids at South Park Elementary are being punished for Cartman's failings in the physical education department. What will Cartman do when they all gang up on him?

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E13 - A History Channel Thanksgiving
15.plot: After watching a Thanksgiving special on The History Channel, the boys believe that aliens were involved in the original feast. But, questions remain... was the first Thanksgiving haunted? Is alien technology responsible for stuffing? The truth could change Thanksgiving for everyone.

15.title: FR - South Park - S15E14 - The Poor Kid
15.plot: With their parents in jail, Kenny and his brother and sister find themselves in the foster care system. Cartman is sincerely disturbed when Kenny is taken away. He doesn't know who to rip on for being the poorest kid in school anymore.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E01 - Reverse Cowgirl
16.plot: One of the boys had been told time and time again about leaving the toilet seat up after he goes to the bathroom, but he didn't listen. His actions have consequences and ultimately result in an unimaginable catastrophe.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E02 - Cash for Gold
16.plot: Cartman launches a gemstones network show and creates a very lucrative business. Stan searches for the real value of a piece of jewelry that was a gift from his Grandpa. Meanwhile, Cartmans lucrative new business preys upon an extremely vulnerable clientele.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E03 - Faith Hilling
16.plot: Mankind's evolution begins to accelerate at a rapid and disturbing pace. Concurrently, another species on the planet is exhibiting the same drastic development. Eventually the two species will battle to the death and "Faith Hilling" may be humanity's only hope.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E04 - Jewpacabra
16.plot: South Park's big Easter egg hunt is in jeopardy when there are rumors of a dangerous beast lurking in the woods nearby. Cartman tries to warn everyone that their lives are at risk if they participate in the egg hunt. No one believes him until he produces video evidence of the mystery being.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E05 - Butterballs
16.plot: Stan wants to raise awareness about the dangers of bullying by shooting a big dance video, while Butters falls victim to an unlikely bully.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E06 - I Should Have Never Gone Ziplining
16.plot: The boys try zip-lining in the Colorado mountains on the last day of spring break, but their adventure takes a dangerous, life-threatening turn.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E07 - Cartman Finds Love
16.plot: There's a new girl in school and everyone wants to know who she has a crush on. Cartman is especially excited. He's discovered something inside himself that he never knew he had. Now, to make sure nobody gets in the way of true love, it's time for Cartman to finally let someone know exactly how he feels.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E08 - Sarcastaball
16.plot: Randy's campaign to prevent head injuries in football radically changes the way the game is played, but the new rules become a national sensation and even make a South Park student a star athlete.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E09 - Raising the Bar
16.plot: Cartman owns up to being fat and decides that driving around on a scooter is his right. Kyle sees that Cartman isn't the only one who finds no shame in his unhealthy lifestyle. Meanwhile, Cartman discovers he has a rival in America’s Sweetheart, Honey Boo Boo.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E10 - Insecurity
16.plot: The man who visits all the homes in South Park every day is under suspicion. Cartman takes matters into his own hands and signs up for a home security system.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E11 - Going Native
16.plot: It is time for Butters to begin a journey where he will follow in the path of his Hawaiian ancestors.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E12 - A Nightmare on Face Time
16.plot: The boys plans to go as the Avengers for Halloween go awry when Randy can’t go at the last minute and Stan has to help his father with a new business venture.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E13 - A Scause for Applause
16.plot: Rocked by the recent news of drug use by a beloved icon, the world is left feeling lost and betrayed. The boys, join with the rest of the nation, and remove their yellow wristbands. Everyone is on board, except for Stan, who just can’t seem to cut off his bracelet.

16.title: FR - South Park - S16E14 - Obama Wins!
16.plot: Eric Cartman is hiding something in his bedroom that could change the entire outcome of the Presidential election.

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E01 - Let Go, Let Gov
17.plot: When Cartman manages to get himself behind the doors of the NSA, he doesn’t like what he finds in his personal file. He thinks it’s time he told everyone the truth. Meanwhile, Butters finds someone new to listen to his prayers.

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E02 - Informative Murder Porn
17.plot: The boys use the game of MINECRAFT as a distraction to keep their parents from hurting each other.

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E03 - World War Zimmerman
17.plot: Cartman is deeply disturbed by a single person who he sees as a threat to all humanity. He races around the country to put an end to Patient Zero, the ticking time bomb that is Token.

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E04 - Goth Kids 3: Dawn of the Posers
17.plot: One of the Goth kids has been sent to a camp for troubled children. When she returns, her friends find her changed in a disturbing way. With their very existence threatened, the Goths have to do something drastic. They are forced to ask the Vamp kids for help.

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E05 - Taming Strange
17.plot: When Ike hits puberty, he and Kyle start to grow apart. To save their relationship, Kyle takes Ike to see a live performance of Yo Gabba Gabba.

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E06 - Ginger Cow
17.plot: Cartman's latest prank has brought about the necessary spiritual conditions for world peace. Religious leaders descend upon South Park to witness a Biblical prophecy that has been fulfilled. Cartman and Kyle are the only two at odds as the world embarks upon a thousand years of peace and harmony.

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E07 - Black Friday
17.plot: Anticipation for the biggest shopping day of the year is building. The dark days of winter are coming and that can only mean one thing: the fight to be the first in the mall on Black Friday has begun. The boys prepare to battle the crowds the day after Thanksgiving to get the best deal on the new gaming systems.

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E08 - A Song of Ass and Fire
17.plot: Hordes of souless shoppers approach the mall in anticipation of the Black Friday sales. The kids prepare for an epic battle where one faction's favorite gaming device will come out on top. Will Stan and Kyle's friendship survive Black Friday?

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E09 - Titties and Dragons
17.plot: The doors to the mall will finally open for the biggest Black Friday sale in history. The boys are divided over which gaming device to buy and a bloody battle will determine whether Xbox or Sony will be the winner.

17.title: FR - South Park - S17E10 - The Hobbit
17.plot: When Wendy tries to prove a point about how much pressure little girls feel to look like celebrities, it gets her in trouble with everyone at school, and gets Clyde a new girlfriend.

18.title: FR - South Park - S18E01 - Go Fund Yourself
18.plot: After Cartman and the boys name their new company, The Washington Redskins, they just sit back and watch the funding roll in. The head coach of the Washington Redskins football team demands that they change the name but Cartman digs in his heels. The Washington Redskins may never mean the same thing ever again.

18.title: FR - South Park - S18E02 - Gluten Free Ebola
18.plot: Mr. Mackey is now gluten free and everyone is annoyed when he won’t quit preaching about how great he feels. But, after witnessing a disturbing demonstration of what happens to your body when you do eat gluten, South Park becomes the first town in America to go gluten free.

18.title: FR - South Park - S18E03 - The Cissy

2.plot: Para desvelar los secretos de "La serpiente emplumada 2", Alex busca la ayuda de un viejo aliado. Pero su propia investigación se empieza a descontrolar y Alan Blunt podría intervenir para detener esta peligrosa misión.

2.title: FR - Alex Rider - S02E06 - Épisode 6
2.plot: Alex, Tom y Kyra vuelan hasta Ámsterdam para infiltrarse en la operación de Damian Cray, mientras el Departamento se centra en el próximo encuentro de Cray con el presidente de EE. UU.

2.title: FR - Alex Rider - S02E07 - Épisode 7
2.plot: Para escapar de Ámsterdam y poder aportar pruebas al Departamento, Alex pide ayuda a Jack, pero esto pone en juego el futuro de su tutora. El presidente de EE. UU. está a punto de aterrizar en Reino Unido. ¿Será demasiado tarde para detener a Cray?

2.title: FR - Alex Rider - S02E08 - Épisode 8
2.plot: El lanzamiento de "La serpiente emplumada 2" se hace efectivo y el plan de Cray sale a la luz. Alex intenta evitar una catástrofe a contrarreloj.

3.title: FR - Alex Rider - S03E01 - Widow
3.plot: Travelling to Malta in search of answers about his father's past, Alex and his best friends uncover the beginnings of a deadly plot by the criminal cabal known as Scorpia and the identity of its charismatic and ambitious new leader.

3.title: FR - Alex Rider - S03E02 - Lab
3.plot: When the British Government receives a threat signifying Scorpia's return, Blunt and the Department begin the hunt. Meanwhile, in Malta, Alex follows the scientist working for them to his secret lab aboard a decommissioned ship.

3.title: FR - Alex Rider - S03E03 - Enemy
3.plot: Alex has been captured and Tom, Kyra, and Jack must scramble to find him. As Scorpia shows the power of their new weapon, Invisible Sword, Alex is confronted by Julia Rothman with some uncomfortable truths about his father.

3.title: FR - Alex Rider - S03E04 - Recruit
3.plot: Cut off from his friends and forced to work with one of his greatest foes, Alex endures a punishing induction to Scorpia, and must face off against a gang of ruthless trainee assassins.

3.title: FR - Alex Rider - S03E05 - Revenge
3.plot: Alex is sent on a mission for Scorpia to prove his loyalty, with Tom and Kyra following close behind hoping to rescue him. Meanwhile, the Department attempts to unlock the secret of 'Invisible Sword'.

3.title: FR - Alex Rider - S03E06 - Target
3.plot: Alex returns home with a dark mission of revenge. Jack, Tom, and Kyra must enlist the help of unlikely allies to save Alex before he commits to Scorpia forever.

3.title: FR - Alex Rider - S03E07 - The Shot
3.plot: Captured and questioned by the Department, Alex must rely on his friends to remind him who he truly is. But are there still truths about his past the Department haven't told him?

3.title: FR - Alex Rider - S03E08 - Invisible Sword
3.plot: As Scorpia orchestrates the final stages of their plan to threaten the lives of an entire city, Alex must go back undercover in a desperate bid to stop Julia Rothman before it's too late.

meta.plot: Will Smith whose curiosity and wonder is positively infectious—is guided by National Geographic Explorers traveling to different corners of the world to get up close and personal with the weirdest, most unusual, dangerous and thrilling spectacles of the planet.

1.title: EN - Welcome to Earth [Multi Sub] - S01E01 - The Silent Roar
1.plot: On a remote island in the Pacific, Will Smith descends into the heart of an active volcano to investigate sounds beyond human hearing. Will discovers that everything on our planet creates its own unique sound—even if we can’t always hear it.

1.title: EN - Welcome to Earth [Multi Sub] - S01E02 - Descent into Darkness
1.plot: In a deep-water submersible, Will Smith descends 3,300 feet to the bottom of the ocean, where even fewer people have gone than outer space. Along the way down, Will and explorer Diva Amon investigate how color is used in the natural world.

1.title: EN - Welcome to Earth [Multi Sub] - S01E03 - Mind of the Swarm
1.plot: Thirty years ago, Will Smith was mesmerized by a photo of the incredible wildebeest migration across the Serengeti in a National Geographic magazine. Now he visits those same wildebeests and discovers an amazing survival strategy.

1.title: EN - Welcome to Earth [Multi Sub] - S01E04 - Power of Scent
1.plot: On the trail of tiger sharks in the Pacific, Will explores the power of smell. For humans, the sense of smell triggers deep memories and emotions, but it has an even more vital function in the animal world.

1.title: EN - Welcome to Earth [Multi Sub] - S01E05 - Speed of Life
1.plot: Will explores the Namibia Desert, where both the landscape and time seem to have stood still for over 50 million years. Will discovers that humans can only see a small sliver of what’s moving around us because everything on the planet is happening either too fast or too slow for us to perceive.

1.title: EN - Welcome to Earth [Multi Sub] - S01E06 - Beyond Fear
1.plot: For Will’s final journey, an ultimate challenge. He and polar explorer Dwayne Fields are dropped by helicopter in the middle of an Icelandic glacier.

meta.plot: Présentée par l’actrice Keke Palmer, « Foodtastic » est une série originale immersive où des artistes recréent des scènes célèbres et réalisent des sculptures à grande échelle à partir d’aliments du quotidien. Des légumes aux fruits en passant par le fromage, les baies ou les noix, ces denrées se transforment en œuvres d’art par l’incroyable créativité que chacun apporte. Chaque épisode s’inspire des différents univers Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars et des Muppets, et ces sculptures alimentaires sont une extension de ces mondes.

FR - The Great - S01E01 - Grandiose
1.plot: En 1761, Catherine se rend en Russie pour se marier à l'empereur Peter, prenant ainsi le titre d'impératrice. Elle rêve du grand amour, mais comprend rapidement que Peter n'est qu'un grand enfant égoïste avec qui elle n'a rien en commun.  Désespérée, Catherine envisage de mettre fin à ses jours. Mais sa servante, Marial, lui propose un autre moyen d'arriver à ses fins : renverser l'empereur.

1.title: FR - The Great - S01E02 - La Fausse Barbe
1.plot: Catherine prépare un coup d'État. Sur les conseils de Marial, elle tente de séduire et de recruter l'intellectuel du palais, le comte Orlo. Sans succès. Cependant, après avoir vu le traitement brutal que Peter réserve aux nobles locaux et son refus d'écouter les conseils de son entourage, Orlo décide de s'allier à Catherine.

1.title: FR - The Great - S01E03 - Vous n'êtes pas Pierre le Grand
1.plot: Catherine, Orlo et Marial poursuivent leur plan de coup d'État. Ils tentent de recruter un malheureux général militaire, Velementov, lors des célébrations du palais en hommage au défunt père de l'empereur, Pierre le Grand. Peter, se rendant compte que sa femme n'est pas heureuse à la cour, lui fait cadeau d'un amant, stérile, Léo. Elle hésite au début, mais le jeune homme parvient à la charmer.

1.title: FR - The Great - S01E04 - Moscow Mule
1.plot: Catherine doit gérer sa réputation à la cour ainsi que sa relation avec Leo, ce qui la détourne du coup d'État. Pendant ce temps, Orlo profite du décès de l'influent patriarche de l'église pour tenter d'influencer Peter dans le choix d'un remplaçant, et Archie passe à l'action.

1.title: FR - The Great - S01E05 - Guerre et Vomi
1.plot: Alors que la guerre contre la Suède fait rage, Catherine et sa tante Elizabeth rendent visite aux militaires sur le front russe. Voir les soldats rappelle à Catherine son objectif de diriger la Russie différemment. Pour mettre fin à la relation entre Peter et Georgina, Grigor décide d'empoisonner l'empereur. Lorsque Peter tombe malade, Velementov, Orlo et Marial essaient tous d'influencer Catherine pour qu'elle prenne le contrôle, alors même que son mari est mourrant.

1.title: FR - The Great - S01E06 - Parachute
1.plot: Après son expérience de mort imminente, une nouvelle vie commence pour Peter. Il est désormais attentif à l'envie de Catherine d'intégrer l'art et la science dans la vie de la cour, mais aussi de faire un enfant.  Orlo essaie de comprendre qui a empoisonné Peter et fait face à ses propres démons.

1.title: FR - The Great - S01E07 - Espoir vérolé
1.plot: Catherine est optimiste quant à sa nouvelle entente avec Peter et leur alchimie croissante. Lorsque la variole ravage les quartiers des domestiques, Peter reprend malheureusement ses anciennes habitudes. Pendant ce temps, la relation de Leo et Catherine bat de l'aile et Peter manque à Georgina.

1.title: FR - The Great - S01E08 - Boulettes à la datcha
1.plot: Les facultés politiques de Catherine sont mises à l'épreuve lorsqu'elle accompagne Peter et Velementov discuter de la fin de la guerre avec le roi de Suède. Velementov voit enfin le potentiel de l'impératrice et décide de la soutenir pour le coup d'État. De retour au palais, Leo veut quitter la cour. Marial essaie de le faire rester en lui parlant du coup d'État.

1.title: FR - The Great - S01E09 - L'amour fait mal
1.plot: Les tensions s'intensifient alors que Catherine, Orlo, Velementov, Leo et Marial tentent de rallier d'autres comtes à leur coup d'État. Quelques hommes finissent par être tués. Quand un corps est découvert plus tard, Peter décide de torturer tout le monde au palais pour trouver les meurtriers. Marial cède à la pression et confie à Archie les plans de Catherine. En parallèle, Catherine se rend compte qu'elle est enceinte.

1.title: FR - The Great - S01E10 - Le Nez du castor
1.plot: Le jour de son anniversaire, Catherine décide de lancer le coup d'État. Peter ne se laisse pas faire et se sert de Leo comme otage. Marial trahit Catherine pour pouvoir retrouver son ancien statut, et révèle à Peter le secret de l'impératrice. Catherine se rend compte que sa seule chance de faire de la Russie un pays meilleur est de se battre, sans Leo. La bataille commence.

2.title: FR - The Great - S02E01 - À moi le trône !
2.plot: Quatre mois après avoir lancé un coup d'État contre son mari, Catherine, enceinte, prend l'avantage dans sa guerre contre Pierre.

2.title: FR - The Great - S02E02 - Épisode 2
FR - The Great - S02E03 - Alone at Last
2.plot: Catherine’s grief over the loss of Leo during the coup finally catches up with her. Peter’s part in Leo’s death, and the discovery that he just murdered a noble, causes Catherine to lock Peter in his apartments with only his mummified mother for company.

2.title: FR - The Great - S02E04 - The Devil's Lunch
2.plot: The Ottoman Ambassador pays Catherine a visit as tensions between the regions run high. But Peter fights to win his allegiance and prove to the court he is more fun than Catherine, in an attempt to destabilize her by throwing a baby shower.

3.plot: Catherine involves the peasants, nobles and merchants in a conference designed to bring change to Russia. Peter’s hunt for revenge on an historic enemy threatens to destabilise Catherine’s attempt to outlaw murder.

3.title: FR - The Great - S03E04 - Stag
3.plot: Arkady and Tatyana help Peter and Catherine through a rough patch as they clash over their son Paul. Catherine fears Paul will grow up to be a ruthless and careless leader and Archie and Elizabeth are alarmed when Catherine refuses to ordain him.

3.title: FR - The Great - S03E05 - Sweden
3.plot: Peter is once again tormented by his father, Peter the Great’s expectations and his failure to continue the legacy of his empire. Catherine must decide what to do about the unrest being stirred up in the regions, but Velementov is in no state to help her.

3.title: FR - The Great - S03E06 - Ice
3.plot: Catherine tries to persuade Peter to come home whilst Hugo re-doubles his attempts to regain his kingdom. Georgina continues to play her complicated court games.

3.title: FR - The Great - S03E07 - Fun
3.plot: Catherine wants to bring more fun to the court. With Georgina’s help she stages a festival of truth, jokes and stunningly clever ideas. Katya puts on a play that challenges Catherine’s reign, and Catherine samples Peter’s invention of salty desserts.

3.title: FR - The Great - S03E08 - Peter and the Wolf
3.plot: Catherine introduces divorce to the court with unforeseen consequences. Grigor befriends Maxim and goes stag hunting, and Elizabeth and Petrov go on a trip to the regions.

3.title: FR - The Great - S03E09 - Destiny
3.plot: Under orders from Catherine, Grigor hides out in the forest with Paul. Catherine plays a dangerous game with herself to prove that her destiny lies in Russia, and grapples with the impact Peter’s decisions have on her rule.

3.title: FR - The Great - S03E10 - Once Upon a Time
3.plot: Catherine meets court scientist Nikolai, who announces a comet is about to pass through Russia. She uses this phenomenon to her advantage and in the face of some huge challenges, unearths a new side of her leadership.

meta.plot: Des jeunes " outsiders " se lancent dans une compétition de danse féroce afin d'intégrer une émission de télé-réalité qui les suivraient pour élir ceux qui feront partis d'un remake du Lac des Cygnes. Ils n'ont peut-être pas des corps de danseurs classiques mais de l'audace et de l'ingéniosité !

1.title: FR - Sissi - S01E01 - Épisode 1
1.plot: Jeune femme de caractère, fougueuse, à la fois enfant de la nature et garçon manqué : voici la duchesse Elisabeth de Bavière, surnommée Sissi ! Celle-ci s'apprête à se rendre à Bad Isch, dans le sud de la Haute Autriche, où sa sœur aînée, la duchesse Hélène "Néné" de Bavière, doit annoncer ses fiançailles avec l'empereur Franz Josef. Sur place, lors d'une poursuite à cheval, Sisi et Franz se retrouvent fortuitement dans une situation périlleuse...

1.title: FR - Sissi - S01E02 - Épisode 2
1.plot: Désormais fiancée, Sissi voit sa vie complètement changer. Son futur est déjà tout tracé et elle doit se préparer rapidement à son prochain rôle : devenir impératrice. Malgré l'amour qu'elle porte à Franz, Sissi peine à le comprendre parfaitement. Fanny, une prostituée, devient une amie inattendue. Elle devient sa dame d'honneur et sa proche confidente. L'évément du siècle approche : le mariage.

1.title: FR - Sissi - S01E03 - Épisode 3
1.plot: La nuit de noces de Sissi est un échec. Mais devant sa mère, l'austère l'archiduchesse Sophie, l'empereur affirme que leur mariage a bien été consommé. Fanny est soupçonnée par la comtesse Esterhazy d'être un imposteur et elle est bannie de la cour. Lors de leur lune de miel, les jeunes mariés se rapprochent. Leur première réception officielle approche et Sissi aide Franz à apaiser les rebelles hongrois.

1.title: FR - Sissi - S01E04 - Épisode 4
1.plot: Sissi et Franz consomment enfin leur mariage et rattrapent le temps perdu. Elle retrouve la trace de Fanny et lui demande conseil pour tomber enceinte, mais elle doit échapper à la surveillance de la cour pour la voir. Pendant ce temps, la situation en Lombardie empire : les rebelles attaquent et tuent le gouverneur. Franz doit faire la guerre, ce qui provoque un mouvement de protestations au sein de la population et risque d'embraser à nouveau la Hongrie.

1.title: FR - Sissi - S01E05 - Épisode 5
1.plot: Franz échappe de justesse à une tentative d'assassinat. La guerre est un désastre pour l'Autriche. Sissi vient en aide à une infirmière dans un hôpital militaire de Laxenbourg. Elle tente de convaincre Franz de rencontrer le comte Andrassy.

1.title: FR - Sissi - S01E06 - Épisode 6
1.plot: Accablés par la douleur de la tragédie, Sissi et Franz rentrent à Vienne avec le corps de la défunte.

meta.plot: Chaque saison retracera la quête de l’amour d’un protagoniste différent et chaque épisode relatera l’histoire d’une de leurs relations. La première saison est centrée sur Darby.

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E01 - Emily à Paris
1.plot: Pleine d'idées novatrices et débordante d'une énergie très américaine, Emily débarque dans son nouveau bureau parisien. Mais, malheur, elle ne parle pas français !

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E02 - Masculin Féminin
1.plot: Emily navigue dans les méandres de l'amour à la française quand son enthousiasme professionnel lors d'une soirée impressionne un client entreprenant... et marié.

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E03 - Sexy ou sexiste
1.plot: Emily exprime ses réserves face à une nouvelle campagne osée, tout en jonglant avec des problèmes de plomberie, des cours de langue et des collègues désagréables.

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E04 - Juste un baiser
1.plot: Une nouvelle connaissance aide gentiment Emily à harponner un client potentiel mais, au bureau, les affres d'une liaison mettent ses négociations en péril.

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E05 - Faux amis
1.plot: Emily découvre que sa popularité croissante sur les réseaux sociaux lui ouvre des portes. Gabriel et Emily se retrouvent seuls lors d'une soirée entre amis.

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E06 - Ringarde
1.plot: Lorsqu'un rendez-vous avec une maison de couture emblématique dérape pour une faute de goût, Emily trouve du réconfort auprès d'un professeur en apparence charmant.

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E07 - Une fin à la française
1.plot: Après avoir accepté de chaperonner une actrice américaine qui vient présenter un gala, Emily voit sa nuit tourner à la catastrophe... avec une célébrité ingérable !

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E08 - Affaires de famille
1.plot: Le week-end d'Emily dans le château d'une amie pétille comme du champagne. À Paris, Mindy revoit à contrecœur de vieilles amies, mais la soirée finit sur une bonne note.

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E09 - Vente aux enchères américaine à Paris
1.plot: Une vente aux enchères, une robe sublime et deux créateurs d'avant-garde s'ajoutent aux soucis d'Emily, qui attire l'attention du potentiel héritier de Pierre Cadault.

1.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S01E10 - Défilé annulé
1.plot: Sur la sellette après sa débâcle lors de la Fashion Week, Emily se démène pour élaborer un nouveau plan tout en se préparant à dire adieu à un bon ami.

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E01 - Voulez-vous coucher avec moi ?
2.plot: Rongée par la culpabilité après de hot retrouvailles avec Gabriel, Emily reprend ses distances en s'accordant un week-end romantique. Mindy fait tapisserie aux toilettes.

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E02 - Bienvenue à Saint-Tropez !
2.plot: Travailler le week-end ? Of course ! Même à Saint-Tropez, Emily ne lâche rien. Pourtant, une bourde sur les réseaux sociaux pourrait vite l'obliger à faire un long break.

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E03 - Bon anniversaire !
2.plot: En pleins préparatifs de son dîner d'anniversaire, Emily a des vapeurs avec Gabrielle et ses amies, et accepte un coup de main de Gabriel... pour le menu.

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E04 - Jules et Emily
2.plot: Quand les aventures intimes d'Emily déteignent sur son job, elle concentre son énergie sur ses cours de français. Mindy ne se laissera pas impressionner par un mime !

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E05 - Un Anglais à Paris
2.plot: Tout en pratiquant son français avec un copain de classe blasé, Emily jongle avec le lancement du restaurant de Gabriel, une soirée Chopard et une Camille machiavélique.

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E06 - Le point d'ébullition
2.plot: La tension monte lors de la soirée d'ouverture de Chez Lavaux. Alfie hérisse Emily en sous-estimant son style et son job. Sylvie attire l'attention d'un photographe.

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E07 - Le cuisinier, la voleuse et l'amant
2.plot: Quand Emily et Alfie cessent enfin de se chamailler, elle croit pourtant prendre une veste alors qu'elle ne l'avait qu'empruntée. Sylvie sort de ses gonds de luxe.

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E08 - Champagne et autres problèmes
2.plot: Après un dîner suspicieusement décadent avec Alfie, Emily rejoint le château de la famille de Camille, où le champagne n'est hélas pas le seul à être sabré.

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E09 - Senteurs et sentiments
2.plot: La patronne d'Emily à Chicago s'intéresse de plus près aux comptes de Savoir, mettant Sylvie sur les nerfs. Une cruelle révélation perturbe la jolie romance de Mindy.

2.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S02E10 - Une révolution française
2.plot: Emily ne sait plus à quelle sainte se vouer quand un défilé de mode à Versailles déclenche une épreuve de force qui pourrait déterminer l'avenir de Savoir, et le sien.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E01 - J'ai deux amours
3.plot: Emily change de coiffure sur un coup de tête. Pour le reste, elle traîne des pieds, n'arrivant à prendre aucune décision concernant sa vie professionnelle ou amoureuse.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E02 - Qu'est-ce que ça veut dire ?
3.plot: Alors que Savoir est dans la tourmente, Emily demande de l'aide à un ancien collègue. Une tentative de détente pendant un gala fastueux tourne vite au vinaigre.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E03 - Le pigeon de la farce
3.plot: Sylvie use de son charme face aux conditions de travail qui se détériorent, Mindy fait des galipettes en coulisses, et Emily prend une décision concernant son avenir.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E04 - Emily part en live
3.plot: En jouant les touristes à Paris, Emily décroche un petit boulot qui met son niveau de français à l'épreuve. Camille séduit une artiste mystérieuse.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E05 - La Liste
3.plot: Emily utilise ses contacts pour faire inscrire Sylvie sur la liste des dix personnes les plus influentes de Paris. Mindy tombe sur un vieil ami. Alfie organise une fête.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E06 - Ex-en-Provence
3.plot: Lors d'un événement automobile, Emily et son équipe séjournent dans un château en Provence. Champs de lavande, gastronomie et invité-surprise… Il y a de la romance dans l'air.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E07 - Comment se faire larguer en beauté
3.plot: L'agence Grateau se retrouve au cœur d'une double catastrophe stylistique. Après avoir reçu une invitation énigmatique, Mindy demande à Emily et Gabriel de l'accompagner.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E08 - Fashion victime
3.plot: L'avenir de Pierre est compromis et les rumeurs vont bon train sur l'ouverture de son magasin. Sylvie contacte une ancienne connaissance. Emily soutient Gabriel.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E09 - Il y a de l'amour dans l'air
3.plot: Alors qu'elle ne sait déjà plus où elle en est avec Alfie, Emily se retrouve dans une situation délicate avec le petit ami de Mindy. Gabriel se concentre sur son avenir.

3.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S03E10 - Oh mon beau château de cartes…
3.plot: Bien occupée à discréditer un collègue et à aider Gabriel à réaliser son rêve étoilé, Emily assiste aussi à une fête champenoise… où les bulles explosent sans sommation.

4.plot: Emily seeks a private spot for a romantic rendezvous, Sylvie calls in a favor for Laurent's club opening, and Mindy's relationship hits an impasse.

4.plot: Looks prove deceiving as Agence Grateau hypes a skincare line and Gabriel's restaurant chases a Michelin star. Trouble brews on Camille's shopping trip.

4.plot: As a new neighbor moves in, Emily does the unthinkable and takes a vacation day, saying au revoir to work — and ciao to a charming tour guide in Rome.

4.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S04E10 - All Roads Lead to Rome
4.plot: Mixing business with pleasure? Not how Emily wants to spend her time in Italy. The stars align for Gabriel, and Mindy finds inspiration among the ruins.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E01 - La Dolce Emily
5.plot: Emily muddies her haute heels to sniff out a fresh opportunity, while Sylvie charms Rome's elite with help from a cash-strapped princess.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E02 - Got to Be Real
5.plot: A fashion faux pas makes Emily question what's authentic and what's not. Mindy gets shaken up when she's enlisted to garnish a colossal cocktail.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E03 - Intimissimi Issues
5.plot: Sylvie and Giancarlo's on-set squabbles drive their production off-script. A revealing lingerie campaign inspires Emily to bare something deeper.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E04 - Rome Has Fallen
5.plot: Sylvie braces for premiere-day criticism in Solitano. Mindy dodges a tough conversation. Emily discovers that viral success isn't all roses.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E05 - Bonjour Paris!
5.plot: Newly returned to Paris, Emily must intervene when a culinary cancellation imperils a hotel opening. Sylvie unexpectedly becomes a plus-one at home.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E06 - The One Where Emily Goes to the Embassy
5.plot: Nostalgic for a taste of home, Emily indulges her sweet tooth on American soil. A crash course in social media sends Sylvie spying on a frenemy's feed.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E07 - Second Chances
5.plot: A mic-drop moment turns heads at a fashion industry conference. After a flood of bad PR, a luxury water brand turns to Agence Grateau to stay afloat.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E08 - Fashion Statement
5.plot: Emily charms a designer's dog to score a meeting. Across town, Sylvie stumbles into scandal at a fête full of family drama.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E09 - La Belle Époque
5.plot: Marcello's dreams hang by a thread when he lands a coveted showcase with a two-week turnaround. A surprise visitor reminds Emily of a bygone era.

5.title: FR - Emily in Paris - S05E10 - Veni, Vidi, Venezia
5.plot: In the sink-or-swim chaos of Venice Fashion Week, Emily scrambles to hit a high-water mark. Back in Paris, the agency faces a tidal wave of its own.

meta.plot: Quand elle décroche le boulot de ses rêves à Paris, Emily, jeune cadre ambitieuse de Chicago, adopte une nouvelle vie tout en jonglant entre marketing, amis et amours.

1.title: FR - Hightown - S01E05 - Tu te sentiras mieux que jamais
1.plot: Jackie se remet à boire, menaçant tout ce pourquoi elle s'est battue, abandonnant sa sobriété et mettant Krista Collins dans une situation dangereuse. Junior doit faire ses preuves d'une nouvelle manière. Ray et Renée ont un rencard.

1.title: FR - Hightown - S01E06 - La baleine blanche
1.plot: Jackie et Junior ont du mal à faire face aux séquelles traumatisantes d'un événement récent. L'enquête de Ray fait des progrès positifs qui pourraient accélérer la recherche des réponses. Ray est prête à soutenir Renee lorsqu'elle en a le plus besoin.

1.title: FR - Hightown - S01E07 - Tout le monde a un cousin à Miami
1.plot: Quand Jackie se rend compte que Junior est impliqué dans le meurtre de Sherry, elle demande l'aide de Ray et de son équipe pour le retrouver. Renee remet en question ses sentiments pour Ray.

1.title: FR - Hightown - S01E08 - #Béni
1.plot: Jackie et Ray essaient de reprendre leur vie, sans grand succès. On suspecte Osito d'être retourné chez lui, en République dominicaine, et l'affaire de Ray cale. Jackie reprend ses vieilles habitudes. Elle recommence à boire comme un trou et coucher avec des femmes différentes chaque soir pour noyer sa peine et oublier sa culpabilité dans la mort de Junior.

Elle est aidée par le détective Ray Abruzzo du groupe de travail antidrogue, qui rêve de vengeance. Le cadavre est celui de son équipier.
Huit histoires célébrant la famille, la foi et le pardon prennent vie dans cette série inspirée de la discographie de Dolly Parton, la reine de la musique country.
